provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle over Z_337 (n=2m=674): H_X=[circ(a)|circ(b)], H_Z=[circ(b)^T|circ(a)^T]. a and b are sparse multiples of the BCH-designed divisor g(x) of x^m-1 (g_int=8243233645511; zero-set run 3, complement run 41), found by Prange search inside the ideal (g). Zero-set design after arXiv:2609.22503 (BCH run-length floors); construction family per arXiv:1904.02703. a=[19, 48, 64, 122, 175, 202, 205, 210, 286]; b=[32, 45, 56, 79, 92, 145, 223, 224, 231].

search_budget.notes: One sweep over BCH-designed divisor ideals on Z_127 and Z_337 (29 records staged, 10 on the mutual Pareto frontier); per-code deep confirm at 100k RIS trials/side; wall clock shared across the batch and inflated by concurrent campaigns on this machine.
